behavioral_features.name: total_attempts
behavioral_features.description: Logical authentication attempts in the run

behavioral_features.name: failed_attempts
behavioral_features.description: Logical attempts with outcome=FAILURE

behavioral_features.name: successful_attempts
behavioral_features.description: Logical attempts with outcome=SUCCESS

behavioral_features.name: failure_ratio
behavioral_features.description: failed_attempts / total_attempts (0 if none)

behavioral_features.name: duration_seconds
behavioral_features.description: Run/sequence duration in seconds

behavioral_features.name: attempt_rate_per_second
behavioral_features.description: total_attempts / max(duration, eps)

behavioral_features.name: failed_count_30s_max
behavioral_features.description: Max FAILURE attempts in any inclusive 30s historical window

behavioral_features.name: failed_count_60s_max
behavioral_features.description: Max FAILURE attempts in any inclusive 60s historical window

behavioral_features.name: failed_count_5m_max
behavioral_features.description: Max FAILURE attempts in any inclusive 5m historical window

behavioral_features.name: success_count_5m_max
behavioral_features.description: Max SUCCESS attempts in any inclusive 5m historical window

behavioral_features.name: unique_users_total
behavioral_features.description: Unique user_id values in the run

behavioral_features.name: unique_users_60s_max
behavioral_features.description: Max unique user_id in any inclusive 60s window

behavioral_features.name: has_multiple_attempts
behavioral_features.description: 1 if total_attempts > 1 else 0

behavioral_features.name: min_inter_attempt_gap_seconds
behavioral_features.description: Minimum gap between consecutive attempts (0 if single)

behavioral_features.name: mean_inter_attempt_gap_seconds
behavioral_features.description: Mean inter-attempt gap (0 if single)

behavioral_features.name: median_inter_attempt_gap_seconds
behavioral_features.description: Median inter-attempt gap (0 if single)

behavioral_features.name: std_inter_attempt_gap_seconds
behavioral_features.description: Population stdev of gaps (0 if <2 gaps)

behavioral_features.name: max_failure_streak
behavioral_features.description: Longest consecutive FAILURE streak

behavioral_features.name: success_after_failure
behavioral_features.description: 1 if a SUCCESS occurs after at least one FAILURE

behavioral_features.name: failures_before_first_success
behavioral_features.description: FAILURE count before first SUCCESS; else all failures

behavioral_features.name: first_attempt_failed
behavioral_features.description: 1 if first attempt outcome is FAILURE

behavioral_features.name: last_attempt_success
behavioral_features.description: 1 if last attempt outcome is SUCCESS

behavioral_features.name: unique_sources_total
behavioral_features.description: Diagnostic: unique source_id (often constant in lab)

behavioral_features.name: text_char_count
behavioral_features.description: diagnostic

behavioral_features.name: text_token_count
behavioral_features.description: diagnostic

behavioral_features.name: text_line_count
behavioral_features.description: diagnostic
